_comment: Spec section 1.2 lists seven trades (incl. Barber and Mechanic). The live
Postgres `Trade` enum has six values (incl. WELDER, no barber/mechanic).
This file represents that mismatch rather than resolving it. A null value
means: assess fully offline, but REFUSE live writeback with
TRADE_NOT_SUPPORTED_BY_DB. Never coerce barber onto PAINTER or mechanic
onto AC_TECHNICIAN — that would silently corrupt worker records.
Adding BARBER/MECHANIC to the enum is a business decision, not a technical
one; spec section 1.2 itself calls the seven 'a starting hypothesis'.
